description: This file defines a dependency injection module using Koin for repositories in the org.qosp.notes project. It sets up bindings for various repository implementations including NoteRepository, ReminderRepository, NotebookRepository, TagRepository, and IdMappingRepository.

classes.name: RepositoryModule
classes.description: Object that encapsulates the dependency injection module for repositories.

methods.name: repoModule
methods.description: Koin module that includes database module and binds repository implementations to their interfaces.
